blocks.text: SOP: road test after brake, steer, or drivetrain work

This is the working cut for RDW-SOP-2023-102 on August 3, 2023. Cal Dreher asked for a written bound after the current path (Around the building, back in the bay) stopped being honest. I am Jeilen Jones, Shop Helper, writing for Cal Dreher, Nina Soto, and Hank Morel. Primary host road.ridgeway.internal. If you are skimming, jump the decision callout, then the refuse on lot loop as the road test, then open questions. If you are on the floor next shift, jump the constraints, the numbers table, and the steps.

Marked route, 35 and a stop. Second person if brakes were opened. Write what changed. Lot loops are not the test. I am not restating a hallway yes. lot loop as the road test is out because July 13 lot loop missed a pull at 35. Customer felt it on the highway. Nina ate the second visit. Cost of doing nothing is already in the numbers: speed=35, visits=2, weeks=2, lot=1, stop=1, highway=1, second=1, write=1. Sibling tickets RDW-3155 and RDW-SOP-2023-008. I will not reopen lot loop as the road test in a side thread because someone asked for a rate waiver. Nina Soto is the acceptor unless the owners line says otherwise.

blocks.text: Background. Why the current path is the wrong tool

Hank Morel owns a leftover that is easy to skip: bay-02.ridgeway.internal. I will ping once. After that the owner is late, not blocked. Unique to this file (49): refuse on lot loop as the road test, lock is marked route, 35, stop, write the change. I will not hide a process change inside a 'quick align' on RDW-3155.
Around the lot is not a road test. The wander shows up at 35.

What a skeptical lead would try first on road.ridgeway.internal: the path Cal Dreher actually has, not an empty-tote photo. Metric I will argue is a clean confirm, not a vanity units-per-hour. If we cannot show that path on shop.ridgeway.internal with the numbers already in this file, we do not have a cut. Jeilen Jones will not accept a hallway yes as that proof.
